feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi dapat pulso lamang ang batayan kung hindi sanay. Tumawag muna ng tulong at AED.
feedback_by_option.en: A pulse check should not be the only gate for an untrained rescuer. Call for help and the AED first.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Humingi muna ng tulong at AED bago hawakan ang manikin; saka sundin ang sequence ng trainer.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Help and the AED are requested before hands touch the manikin; then follow the trainer's sequence.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata. Sundin ang kasalukuyang sequence na ipinakita ng trainer.
feedback_by_option.en: The old CAB paragraph is not certification. Follow the current sequence the qualified trainer demonstrates.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi nagko-compression sa totoong tao. Gamitin ang aprubadong manikin.
feedback_by_option.en: Compressions are not practised on a live person. Use the approved manikin.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi sertipikasyon ang pagbasa ng lumang CAB talata; sinasanay ito kasama ang kwalipikadong trainer.
feedback_by_option.en: Reading the old CAB paragraph is not certification; the skill is practised with a qualified trainer.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Sinasanay ang compression at AED prompts sa aprubadong kagamitan habang nanonood ang trainer.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Compressions and AED prompts are practised on approved equipment with the trainer watching.
